location: Revised article, section 1.2, Composition and the endomorphism algebra
quotedSentence: Horizontal tensor product is also bilinear on maps, over the group algebra of the common region.
issue: For a noncommutative common group algebra R, the bimodule-map hom-spaces generally have no natural R-module structures, so R-bilinearity on maps is not generally defined.
witness: For the regular (R,R)-bimodule, the assignment m ↦ m r for a noncentral r is not right R-linear: at m=1, f(s)=s r while f(1)s=r s, for some s with sr≠rs. Thus right multiplication by r does not give an R-scalar action on bimodule maps.
correction: Horizontal tensor product of bimodule maps is complex-bilinear; the underlying bimodules are tensored over the group algebra of the common region.
scope: The wording concerns the ground ring of bilinearity on morphisms. It does not establish an error in the paper’s evaluated diagram identities.
